statement: Gap causes beyond the four named (N-0110 repair). Question: should a gap that CIP can trace to a report repeating the previous report's figures, or to weeks with no report in the window, be shown as a data gap rather than a stock difference? Options: (1) yes, as two more causes ahead of unexplained (built); (2) no, leave them unexplained (206 of 243 flagged would read as stock differences); (3) treat a repeated report as a load error and refuse it at upload. Evidence: Computer Mania 2025-12-29, 2026-03-30, 2026-06-29 and 2026-09-28 store identical figures from different files (108 flagged); 58 short gaps have windows with unreported weeks. Assumptions: identical figures in two reports are not real; missing weekly reports hide sales. Sign rule: unmatched and no-POD shipments explain only over gaps, unreported weeks only short gaps. Impact: unexplained 206 -> 40. Reversible: classifier only, no number changes. Resolving experiment: ask Computer Mania whether those four reports were refreshed.
